description: This file contains utility functions for constructing absolute URLs that respect proxy prefixes, primarily used in an Express.js server environment. It includes functions to extract proxy prefixes from request URLs, determine the origin URL considering proxy headers, and build complete URLs with optional proxy prefixes.

methods.name: getProxyPrefix
methods.description: Extracts a proxy prefix from the request URL if present, e.g., /proxy/3001. Returns an empty string if not proxied.

methods.name: getOrigin
methods.description: Builds the origin URL (protocol + host) from the request, respecting trust proxy settings and headers.

methods.name: buildAbsoluteUrl
methods.description: Constructs an absolute URL for a given path, automatically inserting proxy prefix if detected.
